consequence.statement: The configuration setting `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` is no longer recognized; any explicit configuration will be ignored and the previous default value `false` will be applied.
consequence.remediation: Remove the `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` setting (and `-tsdb.shipper.use-boltdb-shipper-as-backup` CLI flag) from your Loki configuration, as the TSDB index is now the stable and recommended type.

original.statement: The configuration setting `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` (CLI flag `-tsdb.shipper.use-boltdb-shipper-as-backup`) has been removed; environments that explicitly set it will have that setting ignored and the previous default value `false` applied.

decision.reason: [ev-cd1836b0f962] says `use_boltdb_shipper_as_backup` (`-tsdb.shipper.use-boltdb-shipper-as-backup`) "was removed" and that "the previous default value `false` is applied". So a value an operator set explicitly is no longer honoured, which is what setting-ignored means. [ev-4c9440970051] confirms the removal in 3.0.0. The proposed statement, remediation and low severity match this evidence and do not claim anything more.
